guards.destroyed_relation: COPY invoked on length- and census-matched negatives
guards.false_copy: COPY invoked on programs with no derivable relation
guards.generic: standard likelihood cost and valid-halt loss versus paired none
guards.oracle: oracle_copy reproduces the frozen target exactly
guards.parameters: total trainable parameters versus the frozen cap
guards.resource: peak memory and wall time versus the baseline smoke shape
guards.validity: predicted_copy valid-halt loss versus the same checkpoint

reasons.compositional_relation_gain: both co-primary strata passed in both seeds and every guard passed
reasons.explicit_relation_gain: the flat affine stratum passed both seeds and the nested stratum did not
reasons.incomplete: missing cell, artifact or hash; truncation; failed reload; unqualified device; corpus defect; malformed case
reasons.no_explicit_relation_gain: the flat affine effect missed its floor in either seed
reasons.unsafe_copy_channel: a generic, destroyed-relation, resource, parameter or validity guard failed

objective.formula: L_total = L_byte + 0.1 * (L_gate + L_action_joint), L_action_joint = -log sum_{a in valid(b)} p_span(a) p_d4(a) p_dx(a) p_dy(a) p_count(a)

r0.fallback_status: withdrawn in v1: the implemented metric was degenerate (granularity 1/batch = 0.125 against a 0.10 floor, and identically zero across repeats). A replacement must be a paired relation-task measurement and cannot exist before R3.

namespaces.bootstrap: connected-component resamples for every paired interval
namespaces.corpus: the scientific traced corpus build, and every split inside it
namespaces.development_corpus: the development traced corpus; disjoint from the above
namespaces.randomization: component-level sign flips for the paired permutation test
namespaces.sentinel: the R0 repeatability sentinel's data and initialisation
namespaces.token: counter-based uniforms for ordinary symbol sampling

stages.R0: qualify model/optimizer/RNG reproducibility on the chosen backend
stages.R1: freeze the traced corpus and this executable contract, tests first
stages.R2: build the deterministic transducer, independent of any neural head
stages.R3: add the bounded span head and prove default checkpoint compatibility
stages.R4: add the auxiliary objective and its accounting
stages.R6: freeze protocol v1 and train the four cells
stages.R7: freeze protocol v2, score once and apply the label

statistics.inference_scope: checkpoint-conditional replication under two named initialisations; not a population-of-models claim
statistics.pairing: frozen case, common random numbers within checkpoint and draw
